# DolceVita Travel

> A student project presenting a fictional travel agency specialising in Italy.

Tour offers, prices and testimonials are demonstration content.
The site does not accept bookings or payments.

## Website sections

- [Our tours](/#tours): Six Italian tour packages with durations and prices.
- [Traveller stories](/#testimonials): Sample traveller testimonials.
- [Plan your trip](/#plan): Trip enquiry call to action.
